title: Data quality audit and remediation
description: Tests completeness and consistency rules, routes exceptions, and verifies corrective actions.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: data-quality-audit-remediation
  title: Data quality audit and remediation
  description: Tests completeness and consistency rules, routes exceptions, and verifies corrective actions.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Improve dataset fitness while preserving an exception audit trail.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 3
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - data-steward
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Dataset and quality rules
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - dataset
          - rules
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: audit
      name: Run quality rules
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      role: Data quality auditor
      prompt: Apply every declared completeness, consistency, and validity rule. Return row- and field-level exceptions,
        severity, and rule evidence.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
    - id: queue
      name: Create exception queue
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      role: Data exception coordinator
      prompt: Group quality exceptions by accountable owner and severity, preserve record identifiers, and order critical
        exceptions first.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - optimization
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
    - id: remediate
      kind: agent
      name: Propose remediation
      role: Data quality analyst
      prompt: For each exception, identify cause, correction, owner, source evidence, and whether correction is safe to
        automate.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: verify
      kind: loop
      name: Verify remediation
      config:
        body:
          - audit
          - queue
          - remediate
        exitCondition: audit.criticalExceptions == 0
        maxIterations: 2
        onExhausted: warn
    - id: data-steward
      kind: approval
      name: Data steward accepts exceptions and fixes
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Audit report, exception queue, and remediation log
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: audit
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: audit
      to: queue
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: queue
      to: remediate
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: remediate
      to: verify
      kind: dependency
    - id: e5
      from: verify
      to: data-steward
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: e6
      from: data-steward
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
    - id: verify-exhausted
      from: verify
      to: data-steward
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exhausted
